provenance: Cloned at the pinned tag by network/guest/build-vibium-x86.sh, not vendored: the module is 3 direct dependencies of ordinary Go and upstream is a live public repository, so this does not carry the risk that made vmvapt worth vendoring. Upstream publishes no 32-bit Linux release asset, so this binary exists only as a cross-build.
verification: binarySha256 held across two builds on one host, but do not treat it as a cross-host check: Go stamps a build ID from the build action graph, so another machine produces different bytes from this same tag. Check size (10555576) and toolchain instead: 'go version -m network/guest/bin/vibium'.
guestLimitation: vibium automates Chrome and there is no 32-bit Linux Chrome. 'vibium install' does not fail on i386; it fetches the linux64 Chrome for Testing build, a 290 MB x86-64 ELF the guest cannot exec. Only version, paths, completion, help and add-skill are usable in the guest.
